# Make timestamp unit names match the value crossing the XPCOM boundary

1108 names its getter sent_timestamp_ms and documents milliseconds, but both adapters multiply Unix seconds by 1,000,000 and pass the value to the database PRTime date. The checked accepted shared trait retains the same suffix/comment and multiplication; its safe wrapper forwards i64 unchanged to SetDate. The conversion is to microseconds, so the naming/documentation is misleading; changing the arithmetic to milliseconds would break this boundary. Name/document the actual unit in a future correction and check active callers first. No date corruption was reproduced and the current file-copy path uses C++ parsing.

Scope: Message header timestamp unit naming contract.
